title: stradler retention policy document
description: One revision of the retention policy of a dataset or an area (retention_version 1). Stored at <record>/retention/v1/<hex>.json. Rules the schema cannot express (digest, pin order, reason length, pins only for dataset scopes, pins inside the lineage, one head per scope) are checked by stradler validate.

scope.description: A dataset (project-relative folder) or every dataset of one area.

keep_last.description: Keep the newest N versions; null: no count rule.

keep_days.description: Keep a version until D days after it was superseded; null: no time rule.

hold_copies.description: Held locations each kept version must have; default 1.

pins.description: Versions kept regardless of the other rules, sorted by snapshot. Dataset scopes only.

reason.description: Free text, at most 200 characters, no paths.

previous.description: Digest of the earlier revision of the same scope; null for the first. Digested, so returning to earlier rules gives a new digest.

merges.description: Optional. Digest of the second head that a merge revision (retention set --merge) absorbs. Digested, so a merge never has the digest of an existing revision.

created.description: When this revision was written (UTC). Not digested.

rules_digest.description: Digest of the canonical JSON of the rules alone: the document without digest, created, previous, merges and rules_digest.

digest.description: Digest of the canonical JSON of the document without digest and created. Names the file.
